No. 20-1775 

In the Supreme Court of the United States 

THE STATE OF ARIZONA, ET AL.,  

PETITIONERS, 

v. 

CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO, ET AL., 

RESPONDENTS. 

THE WASHINGTON PLAINTIFFS’  
BRIEF IN OPPOSITION 

ROBERT W. FERGUSON 
   Attorney General 

NOAH G. PURCELL 
   Solicitor General 
   Counsel of Record 

TERA M. HEINTZ 
   Deputy Solicitor General 

1125 Washington Street SE 
Olympia, WA   98504-0100 
360-753-6200 
noah.purcell@atg.wa.gov

1 

REASONS FOR DENYING PETITION 

The  Washington  Plaintiffs—the  States  of 
Washington,  Colorado,  Delaware,  Hawaii,  Illinois, 
Maryland,  Massachusetts,  Michigan,  Minnesota, 
Nevada, New Jersey, New Mexico, Rhode Island, and 
Virginia (the Washington Plaintiffs)—hereby join the 
briefs in opposition to the petition for writ of certiorari 
filed  by  the  Federal  Respondents  and  the  State  of 
California. The Washington Plaintiffs agree that the 
petition for writ of certiorari should be denied for all 
the reasons stated therein. 

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED. 

ROBERT W. FERGUSON 
   Attorney General 

NOAH G. PURCELL 
   Solicitor General 
   Counsel of Record 

TERA M. HEINTZ 
   Deputy Solicitor General
